description: ElectroTest: I'm an electrician and have worked for several companies (design, installation, and maintenance). Now, I work for myself as an entrepreneur. At each site, I have to  equipment and cables. Of course, there are regulatory documents and standarts, but in contentious situations, my test setup helps me. It allows me to make reliable and cost-effective decisions, which also increases the safety of electrical networks. On this channel, I will post videos testing wires, cables, circuit breakers, connections and other electrical equipment. Subscribe, and I hope you’ll find it interesting!
